titulo: UK-EU reset talks will go ‘down to the wire’ as crunch summit approaches
cuerpo: Two sides find provisional compromise on scheme but food and farming negotiations go down to the wire UK-EU summit live – latest news updates British and European negotiators were closing in on a reset deal on Thursday night as they provisionally agreed to allow 100,000 EU citizens to come to the UK every year under a new mobility scheme. It is understood the EU dropped its demands at the last minute that its students should pay home tuition fees if they attended British universities in a concession to get the deal over the line.
